sanskrit: namaḥ sakalakalyāṇamayakaivalyadāyine / śivāya śamitāśeṣabhavādhvadhvāntabhānaveaśeṣadarśanāveśaviśeṣādhivivarjitam / svasaṃvedanasaṃvedyaṃ svasthaṃ vande paraṃ śivamnirastakalpanājālavikalpaughavighātine / namo 'stu paramānandapadātītāya śambhavejayanty apārasaṃsārasārāsāravibhāgadāḥ / kaivalyajñānasaṃbodhahetavaś śambhavāṅghrayaḥmano buddhir ahaṃ prāṇās tanmātrendriyajīvanam / yaṃ dṛṣṭvā vinivartante tam upāsyam upāsmahemamāham iti hṛdgranthicchedanaikakṛpāṇikām / spandāspandakṛtagrāsāṃ naumy ahaṃ śuddhasaṃvidam
source_edition: GRETIL (Hanneder ZDMG 2017), 33 verses [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: vyapadeśavihīnasya tattvasya kathanaṃ katham / svasaṃvedanasadyuktyā gamyate yadi kenacitjñānayogopadeśena yasya nāśvāsa āntaraḥ / samāśvāsavihīnatvāt kathaṃ naiḥśreyasaṃ phalamupeyaprāptyupāyo 'yaṃ svabodhe jāgarūkatā / svabodhajāgarūkatvān nirvibhāgā sthitir muneḥupāyo nāparaḥ kaścit svasattānugamād ṛte / tām evānusaran yogī svastho yaḥ sa sukhī bhavetsvasaṃkalpaparāmarśād viśuddhajñānasaṃśrayāt / paramāhlādalābhāc ca bodhaikaghanatā muneḥnigṛhīte svasaṃkalpe śakteḥ śaktimati sthitiḥ / śaktiśaktimator aikyam ity upeyaṃ ca yogināmprāpte svarūpavijñāne santyakte tattvakañcuke / udyogakāraṇe kīrṇe muktaḥ sa kila kathyatebodhamātre grahaḥ kāryaḥ suprabuddhena cetasā / tāvad yāvat svasāmarthyāt svaniṣṭhaḥ kevalo bhavet
source_edition: GRETIL (Hanneder ZDMG 2017), 33 verses [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: sarvadā suprabuddhas san paśyaty ātmānam ātmanā / draṣṭuḥ svarūpasaṃsthasya kim anyad avaśiṣyatesadaiva suprabuddhatvam etāvan manasaḥ kṣayaḥ / tatkṣayād yogināṃ samyaksākṣātkāro bhavaty alamparyāvṛttaḥ svasaṃvittau vartate yas tv abhedataḥ / sa samrāḍ yogayuktānām ajñānadhvāntabhāskaraḥsvarūpānubhavāhlādadaśātītendusaṃsthitiḥ / avāptavyaṃ kim astīha kṣīṇāntaḥkaraṇasya mesvaparijñaptiviśrāntī sudṛḍhe yasya susphuṭe / tasya vṛttivimuktasya bhavet kevalatācirātgrāhyagrahaṇasaṃskāratiraskāraikacetasām / yogināṃ svātmaniṣṭhānāṃ mokṣalakṣmīr na durlabhālabdhā svarūpaviśrāntir nirvṛttā kleśasantatiḥ / grāhyagrāhakatā bhagnā svarūpastho' smi saṃsthitaḥabhedabodhasaṃbodhasvarūpānubhavasthitim / vyutthitaḥ sanniruddho vā labhate yaḥ sa tattvavityasya sarvāsv avasthāsu svasthitir naiva lupyate / tasya kiṃ nāma kurvanti śāstrabhramaṇavibhramāḥvigalitasadasadvikalpasadasadbhramajanitamohamuktātmā / jīvann api janamadhye vigatabhayaḥ sarvadā yogī
source_edition: GRETIL (Hanneder ZDMG 2017), 33 verses [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: nirastakaraṇo yena samādhiḥ sevitaḥ sakṛt / paraḥ sākṣātkṛtas tena caritārthena yogināahamātmany asambhinnaḥ saṃgṛhya svaprayatnataḥ / prabuddhaḥ syāt svaniṣṭhaḥ san yāvat sādāśivadyutiḥnirastasarvārthaniraṃśavṛttir jñānī sakṛt svātmani labdhalābhaḥ / samyaṅnibodhaikaparaḥ svaniṣṭhaḥ svakañcukaṃ hanta jahāti yogīvāganubhavasadyuktir yasyāsti nirantaraṃ svasaṃvittau / tasyopadeśakaraṇaṃ yuktaṃ śiṣyeṣu bodhanaṃ samyaknairvāsanyāt svasaṃbodhāt tyāgād āśābhimānayoḥ / sadasatpadavicchedān na punar vigrahagrahaḥāśvastāntaḥkaraṇaḥ kṣīṇavikalpaḥ svarūpalābharataḥ / svānubhavāmṛtatṛptaḥ kaivalyaṃ yāti caritārthaḥittham upeyaprāptau vigatamalā citprakāśikā satyā / kaivalyabhūtijananī svabodhasiddhir mayā gaditāyenopadeśena nalabdhalābho bhavaty alaṃ saṃśayadoṣamuktaḥ / tenopadeśena nasaṃśayena kiṃ nāma kuryād bahuśāstrapāṭhīaśeṣakṛtamaṅgalaṃ vividhakarmadāvānalaṃ svarūpapadadarśakaṃ sakalakalpanāvarjitam / samastasukhamandiraṃ vividhaduḥkhamūlacchide namāmy asamasundaraṃ gurumukhopadiṣṭaṃ śivam
